findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison endpoint contrasts are strongest and most reproducible for the short-range pair kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (endpoint_effects:9, integrated z 0.562, positive_batch_fraction 1.0, q 1.5e-4), pair_kernel_2.5 (endpoint_effects:10, z 0.631, q 2.2e-5) and pair_kernel_3.5 (endpoint_effects:11, z 0.540, q 9.8e-5), with pair_kernel_5.0 weaker (endpoint_effects:12, z 0.319) and pair_kernel_7.0 reversed (endpoint_effects:13, z -0.485). The same ordering appears in the branch-adjusted raw and adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241 positive; branch_adjusted:167/244 negative for 7.0 A). These are selection-enrichment contrasts on a radial pair-distance shell density, not absolute geometric descriptors and not interaction energies.

Shape (global pose/shape) contrasts are negative and reproducible for shape_yy (endpoint_effects:4, z -0.513, positive_batch_fraction 0.0, q 1.5e-5) and shape_xx (endpoint_effects:3, z -0.495, q 8.1e-4), with shape_yz also negative (endpoint_effects:8, z -0.212) and shape_zz weaker (endpoint_effects:5, z -0.183). The branch-adjusted raw and adjusted correlations agree in sign for shape_yy (branch_adjusted:158, 235). These are global shape-moment contrasts, not local coordinate information.

Landmark softmin and occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions rather than a single shared direction: softmin is negative at landmarks 00, 04, 06, 10, 18, 19 (endpoint_effects:14, 26, 32, 44, 68, 71) and positive at 01, 02, 03, 05, 12, 15, 16 (endpoint_effects:17, 20, 23, 29, 50, 59, 62); occupancy3 is positive at 00, 04, 07, 10, 13, 19 (endpoint_effects:15, 27, 36, 45, 54, 72) and negative at 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 12, 15, 16, 18 (endpoint_effects:18, 21, 24, 30, 33, 51, 60, 63, 69). A sign on one landmark observable cannot be transferred to another as a shared quality axis.

Global centroid contrasts are weak and not reproducible: endpoint_effects:0 (x, z -0.111), endpoint_effects:1 (y, z -0.243, q 0.014) and endpoint_effects:2 (z, z -0.061) are small, and the branch-adjusted adjusted-covariance centroid entries (branch_adjusted:77-79) are all non-significant (q 0.86-0.97). Centroid displacement is not a supported favorable direction.

Joint-motion diagnostics are the most reproducible branch-adjusted signals: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are negative under both raw and adjusted covariance (branch_adjusted:74/76, 151/153) and under raw and adjusted correlation (branch_adjusted:228/230, 305/307), with same_sign_batch_fraction up to 1.0 and q as low as 9.3e-5. This indicates that lower joint innovation/internal residual is associated with the favorable side, but it is a joint-motion diagnostic, not a coordinate reward target.

Within-selector joint diagnostics show that innovation is positively associated with native alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, mean 0.092, q 2.2e-9) and with teacher innovation-contrast alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, mean 0.226, q 2.2e-9), while it is negatively associated with observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:2, mean -0.036, positive_batch_fraction 0.0, q 1.8e-7). Teacher contrast is dominated by the internal fraction (joint_diagnostics:14, mean 0.787) rather than translation (joint_diagnostics:12, 0.132) or rotation (joint_diagnostics:13, 0.081).

The supplied continuous contrast functions for landmark 00 are observed-node linear interpolations over the complete observed support [0.0, 0.49] with no extrapolation allowed, and they show sign changes and rate changes within the window (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass first_rate_z 9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00; landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z -72.4 and last_rate_z 5.52). A constant rule is therefore not equivalent to a time-conditioned rule on this evidence, but the curves are contrasts, not absolute reward targets.

Curve fidelity is limited: the landmark-00 continuous fits are not accepted as polynomials (polynomial_accepted false), relative node RMSE ranges roughly 0.29-0.87, and the curve_support audit reports relative_node_rmse 0.58-0.67 with strong_sign_conflict_nodes of 1-5 for the audited landmark-00/02/03/04/05/06 features. The audited selection rule retained only 24 of the candidate curves (relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0), so most supplied curves do not meet the fidelity bar.

Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity: survival_enrichment_z is positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (survival_effects:0, z 0.365, q 0.120), landmark_02_local_dz (survival_effects:23, z 0.206), landmark_04_local_czz (survival_effects:46, z 0.266), landmark_07_soft_mass (survival_effects:70, z 0.220), landmark_10_soft_mass (survival_effects:100, z 0.234) and landmark_18_local_czz (survival_effects:186, z 0.217), and the survival change-rate is strongly positive for landmark_04_local_cyz (survival_effects:249, z 1.79, q 0.302). Because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, these cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts disagree with the population endpoint contrasts in several places: increment_effects:14 (landmark_00_softmin, z -4.91, q 0.046) and increment_effects:15 (landmark_00_occupancy3, z 4.28, q 0.081) are large, while increment_effects:3/4 (shape_xx, shape_yy) are negative (z -3.70, -3.85) and increment_effects:10 (pair_kernel_2.5) is positive (z 3.96, q 0.208). This disagreement should affect direction priorities rather than being averaged away.

Turnover accounting separates within-path change from changing cohort composition: population_rate is small for most features (e.g. turnover:0, 0.185), while edge_rate and turnover_residual_rate are large and often opposite in sign (turnover:1 edge 4.55 vs turnover:2 residual -4.36 for landmark_00_soft_mass; turnover:14 residual 4.29 for landmark_00_local_cxx; turnover:17 residual 5.05 for landmark_00_local_cyy; turnover:134 residual 5.67 for landmark_04_local_cxx; turnover:224 residual 5.08 for landmark_07_local_cxx; turnover:254 residual 5.54 for landmark_08_local_cxx; turnover:497 residual 6.37 for landmark_16_local_cyy; turnover:524 residual 5.24 for landmark_17_local_cxx; turnover:584 residual 5.30 for landmark_19_local_cxx; turnover:587 residual 5.37 for landmark_19_local_cyy). The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Coverage and label limitations constrain interpretation: the information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092) and top4_teacher_overlap 0.470, and lineage_support records 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6 ancestors out of 700 batch nodes, with terminal metadata at score time 0.99 and state time 1.0. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

hypotheses.claim: Hypothesis: a coordinate intervention that increases short-range pair-kernel density (1.5-3.5 A) while decreasing the 7.0 A shell would move the endpoint contrast in the favorable direction. Observable: pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5/7.0. Intended response: positive change in 1.5-3.5 A kernels and negative change in 7.0 A. Target origin: evidence-bound landmark regions with the strongest short-range contrasts. Scale: pointcloud_delta_A in the registered set. Discriminating failure: if the 1.5-3.5 A kernels do not move together or the 7.0 A kernel does not decrease, the hypothesis is not supported.

Hypothesis: reducing global shape_yy and shape_xx while leaving surrounding coordinates free would move the endpoint contrast favorably. Observable: shape_xx, shape_yy, shape_yz. Intended response: negative change in shape_yy and shape_xx. Target origin: global shape moments, not local regions. Scale: pointcloud_delta_A in the registered set. Discriminating failure: if shape_yy and shape_xx do not both decrease, or if the change is accompanied by a compensating increase in shape_yz, the hypothesis is not supported.

Hypothesis: reducing joint innovation and internal RMS is associated with the favorable side. Observable: joint_innovation_RMS_A, joint_internal_RMS_A. Intended response: negative change in both. Target origin: joint-motion diagnostics, not a coordinate reward target. Scale: pointcloud_delta_A in the registered set. Discriminating failure: if joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A do not move together, or if the change is not reproducible across independent batches, the hypothesis is not supported.

Hypothesis: a time-conditioned regional attention rule using the validated absolute contrast changes at actual score nodes would differ from a constant rule on the landmark-00 features. Observable: landmark_00_soft_mass, landmark_00_local_dy, landmark_00_local_cxx. Intended response: time-varying regional attention that follows the observed sign changes. Target origin: evidence-bound landmark and verified continuous salience. Scale: temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend in the registered sets. Discriminating failure: if the time-conditioned rule does not differ from the constant rule on the observed support, or if it requires extrapolation beyond [0.0, 0.49], the hypothesis is not supported.

Hypothesis: the positive survival-enrichment signals at landmarks 00, 02, 04, 07, 10 and 18 reflect selection enrichment rather than final affinity benefit. Observable: survival_enrichment_z and survival_enrichment_change_rate_z. Intended response: no change in final predicted affinity if the signal is selection-only. Target origin: recorded joint-head credit. Scale: not applicable without decoded terminal labels. Discriminating failure: if decoded terminal labels become available and the survival signal does not predict final affinity, the selection-only interpretation is supported.

Hypothesis: the large turnover residuals at landmarks 00, 04, 07, 08, 16, 17 and 19 reflect changing cohort composition and score reclassification rather than within-path coordinate change. Observable: population_rate, edge_rate, turnover_residual_rate. Intended response: no change in within-path coordinate trajectories if the residual is composition-driven. Target origin: turnover accounting. Scale: not applicable. Discriminating failure: if within-path coordinate trajectories change in the same direction as the residual, the composition-only interpretation is not supported.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; moment effects, pair kernels and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only.
